summary: GEN Restaurant Group disclosed an at-the-market style equity purchase facility, not a repurchase: an 8-K reporting a Common Stock Purchase Agreement and Registration Rights Agreement dated September 29, 2026 with Roth Principal Investments, LLC, letting the Company sell up to $25,000,000 of newly issued Class A common stock at its sole discretion over up to 36 months after an effective resale registration. Sales occur via market-open, intraday, pre-market or post-market purchases subject to a minimum threshold price. No price per share, premium, board recommendation or advisor named. Watch dilution, registration effectiveness and any pricing floor reset.
